//: Capability manifest for <Grid> — svelte-pure-admin. See accent-grid.map.json for the container model. Grid.svelte renders `<div class="pc-row …">` with no-gutter/same-height/justify/valign modifiers + a class passthrough + children slot. `justify` maps to the `justify` prop (center|end|between|around); `valign` maps to the `align` prop (top|middle|bottom|stretch). Gap spacing is the component's `gap` prop → `gap-*` utility, out of scope (shared utility, not a pc-row modifier).
